source: Connected Linear read, 2026-10-18; source text is requirement evidence only, never execution evidence

issues.title: M01.01 — Lock retail restocking dataset and output contract

criteria.text: Customer step 1 requires only supplying files and stating the problem; data joins/preparation occur later in [DSC-27](https://linear.app/gr3enarr0w/issue/DSC-27).
One source/operational-input/output contract is locked with shared Drive links; no additional scenario suite is required.
Missing-input assessment, runtime error and completed restocking have distinct outcomes.
Analytical uncertainty triggers investigation/sensitivity checks before targeted business clarification.
Synthetic operational inputs and unresolved source meanings remain visibly distinct from observed facts.
No model/pipeline implementation is claimed by this planning update.

issues.title: M01.02 — Build retail capability assessment and initial customer sign-off

criteria.text: Step2 forms and presents the proposed task; absent/inaccessible/incomplete data produces specific required-data guidance before sign-off.
Approval binds to the current step2 proposal; rejection/correction/new material input returns to step2, and no response waits without analytical execution.
Compatible partial schemas are handled; a genuinely different business task is identified without silent rerouting.
No unnecessary customer choice of imputation, algorithms or hyperparameters.
Material assumptions appear in the initial understanding and remain traceable.

issues.title: M01.03 — Integrate Codex with OpenAI Data and verify real analytical execution

criteria.text: Supported Codex/Data invocation and a real bounded execution are evidenced before integration is accepted.
Capability assessment, needs-material-facts, analytical success and runtime failure remain distinct.
Source/task/assumption versions and actual checkpoint evidence are returned.
Missing plugin, invalid code, timeout and exhausted-budget paths are inspectable.
No unsupported interface or completed engineering is claimed.

issues.title: M01.04 — Execute cleanup, EDA and initial features

criteria.text: EDA/feature findings and relevant analytical choices are retained for the final report; no interim customer analysis-progress update is emitted.
Required joins/alignment occur in this preparation stage; key coverage, cardinality, reconciliation and source lineage are checked.
CSV source/duplicate reconciliation, dictionary mappings and Product_ID/Store_ID transaction-grain evidence are retained.
Aggregation and missingness decisions are made and tested by the agent.
Units and outliers are resolved, bounded or flagged with consequences—not silently fabricated.
Future features and fitted preprocessing do not leak validation/holdout information.
No customer statistical-treatment gate is introduced.

issues.title: M01.05 — Implement initial benchmark, LLM feature generation, comparison and validation

criteria.text: Failed step9 validation receives an internal parent check; confirmed failure or unresolved bounded recovery ends with a verified customer explanation and no restocking recommendation or second-best-model retry.
The explicit sequence is initial-model/baseline evaluation (step6) → LLM-generated additional features (step7) → bounded model/feature comparison (step8) → frozen unseen validation.
LLM feature definitions and materialized outputs are traceable, prediction-time available, fold-safe and checked by the parent; original features remain a comparison reference.
Comparable baseline/candidate evidence and correct metric direction are recorded.
Train/development/holdout boundaries, eligibility and prediction-time features are checked.
Passing, worse and equal branches match the contract.
Fully observed development/holdout windows obey the cutoff; the final pass/fail rule is frozen before scoring and failure blocks delivery without optimization.
Stockout/profit/inventory-cost improvement is not claimed from forecast accuracy alone.

issues.title: M01.06 — Prepare the requested final business output

criteria.text: Supported-input and insufficient-input customer responses are both grounded in evidence.
Alternatives are offered without silently replacing the requested task.
Synthetic provenance/material limitations remain clear.
The final report contains the restocking list and concise verified EDA/feature findings; raw code and detailed diagnostics remain internal, with no interim analysis-progress message.
No false unsuitability or execution-success claims.

issues.title: M01.07 — Verify and deliver the final business output

criteria.text: Final quantities reconcile to forecast, stock and eligible receipts without double counting.
Units, dates, rounding and applicable constraints are checked.
Missing/invalid/stale/conflicting inputs produce explicit correct handling.
Synthetic output is illustrative, not a real purchasing recommendation.
The delivered final report's list, EDA/feature summary and limitations match verified artifacts; a blocked task receives the supported capability response.

issues.title: M01.08 — Record the real demonstration and collect review evidence

criteria.text: Future recording proves real execution of the one selected restocking case; no extra scenario suite.
Source, synthetic inputs, assumptions and actual outputs are distinguishable.
Missing-input success is not mislabeled as full end-to-end restocking success.
No app launch/delivery or extra V1 workflow is required.
Recording and versioned evidence agree.

issues.title: M01 — Implement MVP human interaction and guardrail contract

criteria.text: Fact/inference/assumption/synthetic/unknown provenance is testable.
The one restocking task distinguishes ready/needs-material-facts capability states from system errors; no nine-dataset requirement.
Cleanup and model choices do not become customer statistical decisions.
Unsupported material facts use targeted review; routine analysis progress stays internal and its relevant findings appear in the final report.
Permissions, isolation, retry/compute budgets, logs and model gates are verifiable.

issues.title: M01.09 — Verify the single retail restocking demo and evidence

criteria.text: Step9 failure is parent-reviewed; confirmed underperformance, failed bounded correction or unresolved execution ends with an evidenced final customer explanation, no restocking list and no second-best-model retry. Runtime failure and measured validation failure are distinguished; this terminal behavior does not by itself prove a successful restocking demonstration.

Execution evidence distinguishes step6's initial-model/baseline gate, step7 LLM-generated and validated additional features, and step8 model/feature comparison before frozen unseen validation; no final-holdout information enters feature generation.
The one end-to-end restocking case maps to actual execution and verification evidence.
Missing-input assessments and actual restocking completion are classified correctly.
No unsupported operational fact, silent task switch or unnecessary statistical question passes.
Full-input demo evidence and affected rechecks are required for gate closure.
Fixture-validation results are not misrepresented as product tests or implementation completion.
